uploadPage.title: Upload Patient Lists
uploadPage.description: Upload images or documents of patient lists to be processed by AI

uploadCard.title: Upload Patient List
uploadCard.description: Upload images of handwritten or typed patient lists. Our AI will extract patient information and update the database.

processing.title: Processing in progress
processing.description: The AI is currently extracting patient information from your uploaded document. This may take a few moments.

complete.title: Processing complete
complete.description: The patient list was successfully processed. Patient records were updated in the database.

error.title: Processing failed
error.description: There was an error processing the patient list. Please try again or contact support.

info.title: Important Information
info.point1: Make sure the document clearly shows patient names and relevant information.
info.point2: The AI processes best when text is clearly legible.
info.point3: Both typed and handwritten text can be processed, but typed text yields better results.

errors.missingInfoDescription: Please select a hospital and make sure an event is selected before uploading.
errors.uploadSuccessDescription: Patient list has been uploaded and will be processed.
